verdict.rationale: cubic's custom agents are documented as review rules that enforce an organization's own best practices. They are configured in a repo-root cubic.yaml, and community-library agents can be adopted with one click. Reviews also pick up repo guideline files (AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .ai/ directories) and Notion pages as context. One community commenter calls plain-text YAML rules a half-measure compared with architectural tests, but that is design skepticism, not a reported failure. missing for 10: AST/structural pattern rules, explicit support for linking external style-guide URLs, independent hands-on confirmation that custom rules are reliably enforced.
